selected_scope.title: LC Office V81 Integration
selected_scope.finding: S1.42AJ remains the unchanged balanced parent and is not accepted. DIAG1 force-selected LC Office and produced a user-reported later-day stutter of roughly 3-4 hitches per second. Exact DIAG2 changes only Piggy.LCOffice [General] Camera Frame Speed to 0 versus DIAG1. The initial DIAG2 run at RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AJ-DIAG2/20260918T144306Z/ was positive but ended before the DIAG1 comparison window. The longer confirmation run is ingested at RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AJ-DIAG2/20260918T153753Z/ with log SHA-256 f347b1ca20ddc82d0fe93a5ca8c536fd7c116061a9080f4711f6bf2ac924329b. LC Office generation completed around 15:24:08 and the round continued until the end-of-day sequence around 15:36:04, roughly 12 minutes later and well beyond DIAG1's approximately 7m39 post-generation span. The user again reported that the characteristic repeated DIAG1 stutter was absent. The log proves repeated elevator operation, a planned 15-scrap spawn count, a Men-stalker vent spawn at 15:25:27 and an Aloe vent spawn at 15:30:05. The user reported isolated frame drops near Men-stalker and continued to perceive LC Office scrap as sparse or poorly distributed. This is sufficient project A/B confirmation to carry Camera Frame Speed = 0 into the next balanced successor, without claiming universal causal proof. Scrap count itself is not proven low by this run; spatial distribution remains a separate investigation.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Prepare the next balanced successor S1.42AK directly from exact S1.42AJ, never from DIAG1 or DIAG2. Carry the DIAG2-validated LC Office setting [General] Camera Frame Speed = 0 into the balanced parent; disable exact package YaBoiDucki-men_stalker 3.1.2; set Biodiversity Aloe [SpawnSettings] PowerLevel = 0. Preserve all unrelated package/config bytes, explicitly leave Wexop-RandomEnemiesSize and wexop.random_enemies_size.cfg unchanged, and do not tune LC Office scrap blindly: investigate quantity versus spatial distribution separately. S1.42AJ remains not accepted and DIAG2 remains diagnostic-only evidence.
